components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^(\D*\d){10}\D*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: Stable shared identifier for owners of the same household (same last name and address), assigned when 'sharesHousehold' is set.
          type: string
          example: '2f1b8c0e-0d3a-3b6e-9f4a-1c2d3e4f5a6b'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's initials, upper-cased and dot-separated, e.g. 'G.F.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', e.g. 'SMI-0007'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year, e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level from 1 to 3: starts at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's region derived from their city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of existing owners sharing the same first and last name (case-insensitively) when this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today, signalling a bulk-signup surge; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's duplicate-detection key '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' (email and householdId empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented optional owner `postcode` support with minimal structural impact by adding small, cohesive units rather than growing existing complex methods.

**Changes (5 files):**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `postcode` property to the `OwnerFields` schema with `pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'`. Since the generator has `performBeanValidation=true`, this produces a `@Pattern` on the generated DTO, so a malformed postcode (e.g. `"12"`) is rejected 400 automatically via `@Valid` — no Java validation code needed. `Owner` inherits the field via `allOf`, so both request and response DTOs gain it.

2. **`Owner.java`** — Added a `postcode` column field plus a trivial getter/setter (CC=1 each). MapStruct auto-maps `postcode` by name in both directions, so `OwnerMapper` needed no changes.

3. **`OwnerPostcodeAdvice.java`** (new) — A self-contained `RequestBodyAdvice` mirroring the existing `OwnerTelephoneLengthAdvice` pattern. It rejects (400) a 4-digit postcode that's out of range for the city's region (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099), while leaving unknown-region cities and absent postcodes untouched, and letting the `@Pattern` handle malformed values. Being a new small class, its surrounding complexity (WMC_other) is minimal.

4. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** — Added the `postcode VARCHAR(4)` column (hsqldb is the complete, test-active schema; h2/postgres/mysql are already stale/incomplete, so I left them as-is per existing convention).

5. **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — Added the extra `NULL` to the 10 seed rows' positional inserts.
